##


The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) year is a unique time for Nigerian graduates. While many see it as just a one-year program, smart corps members use this period to **build something for their future** . With the right mindset and strategies, you can start a **profitable business** that continues even after NYSC.


You can start a thriving business during your service year. In this guide, we’ll walk you through **why** starting a business during NYSC is a smart move, the best business ideas to consider, and the steps to make it a reality.


## Why Start a Business During NYSC?


1. **Financial Independence** – The monthly **allowance** from the government might not be enough to cover all expenses. A business helps you earn extra income.
2. **Low Risk** – With free time and minimal responsibilities, this is the best time to experiment without fear of major financial loss.
3. **Early Start** – Instead of waiting to find a job after service, you would already have something growing.
4. **Networking Opportunities** – You meet people from different backgrounds who can be **potential customers, partners, or investors** .
5. **Skill Development** – Running a business sharpens **problem-solving, marketing, and financial management skills** .


## Profitable Business Ideas for NYSC Members


Not every business requires huge capital. Here are some low-cost, high-return businesses:


### 1. **Freelancing & Online Services**


If you have a skill, monetize it!


- Graphic design
- Social media management
- Copywriting and content creation
- Video editing
- Website design


You can leverage websites like[Hubspot](https://www.hubspot.com/) and[Coursera](https://www.coursera.org/) to learn and polish your skills


### 2. **Mini Importation**


Buy affordable products in bulk from China, Turkey, or the UK and sell them online. Focus on:


- Fashion accessories (watches, sunglasses, bags)
- Phone gadgets
- Beauty products


### 3. **Food Business**


Food is a necessity. You can start small with:


- Home-cooked meals for fellow corps members
- Baking (cakes, chin-chin, small chops)
- Smoothie and fruit juice production


### **POS Business with Lenco**


With cash scarcity and poor banking networks, a **POS business** is profitable. **[Lenco](https://lenco.co/) provides a reliable and easy-to-use POS service** to help corps members earn income through transaction charges. You can quickly get started with minimal capital and earn on every withdrawal or transfer.


Get answers to some of the[Frequently Asked Questions About Lenco POS System](https://blog.lenco.ng/frequently-asked-questions-about-lenco-pos-system/) here.


### 5. **Tutoring & Skill Training**


Many people are willing to pay for knowledge. If you’re good at:


- Teaching primary/secondary school students
- Training people on digital skills (design, coding, marketing)
- Organizing extra lessons for JAMB/WAEC students


### 6. **Fashion & Beauty Services**


If you’re skilled at:


- Hairdressing/barbing
- Make-up artistry
- Tailoring & fashion design
- Nail fixing & pedicure


These services are always in demand!


## Steps to Start a Business During NYSC


### 1. **Identify Your Strengths & Interests**


Pick a business that aligns with **your skills and passion** . It should be something you enjoy doing and can sustain. Evaluate your abilities and consider businesses that fit your current location and available resources.


### 2. **Start with Low Capital**


Many businesses require little to no capital. Leverage your NYSC allowance and **start small** . Consider businesses that allow you to begin with minimal inventory or those that require only your expertise, such as freelancing or tutoring.


### 3. **Leverage Social Media**


Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and TikTok can be your **free marketing tools** . Create engaging content, post customer testimonials, and **use word-of-mouth referrals** . Consistency is key—keep your audience engaged with valuable posts and promotions.


### 4. **Offer Quality Services & Discounts**


Attract your first customers with **affordable prices and promotions** . Satisfied customers will refer more people! Running a promo or offering referral discounts can help spread the word about your business.


### 5. **Use Lenco for Easy Business Transactions**


Lenco provides **business-friendly banking solutions** that help you manage your finances efficiently. With a **Lenco business account** , you can:


- **Receive payments seamlessly** via bank transfers or POS transactions
- **Get a POS machine to earn extra income** by offering cash withdrawals
- **Track your earnings and expenses effortlessly** with Lenco’s digital dashboard
- **Enjoy zero hidden fees and fast transactions** that help maximize your profit
- **Access financial tools to grow your business** and plan for the future


### 6. **Save & Reinvest Your Profit**


Instead of spending all your earnings, **save and reinvest** into growing your business.


### 7. **Utilize NYSC Support Programs**


NYSC offers business funding programs like:


- **SAED (Skills Acquisition and Entrepreneurship Development)** – Free training on various business skills. Take advantage of the workshops and mentorship programs to refine your business idea.
- **BOI NYSC Loan** – The Bank of Industry (BOI) provides loans to corps members starting businesses. Research the requirements and apply to secure additional funding for scaling your business.


## Conclusion


Your NYSC year is more than just a phase—it’s an opportunity! Instead of waiting for job openings, **create your own path by starting a business** . With the right business idea, smart planning, and consistency, you can build something that sustains you even after NYSC.


**Are you ready to start? Take action today and secure your financial future!**
